defects.description: Root current-facing GITHUB_READY_STATUS.md and VERIFICATION_STATUS.md identified the working package as v1.5.3 / versionCode 18 even though the sealed continuation is v1.5.4 / versionCode 19, and retained stale earlier verification counts.
defects.rootCause: Predecessor release-readiness files were carried forward without a current-state override or historical label when the v1.5.4 continuation identity changed.
defects.remediation: Reconcile both files to v1.5.4/versionCode 19, preserve v1.5.3 explicitly as production authority, and add deterministic regression coverage for current-facing release identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Both current-facing files identify v1.5.4 and versionCode 19
Both preserve v1.5.3 as production authority
Full available local regression and clean-package verification pass
defects.verification: Acceptance is verified by the final clean-package/post-seal evidence for this R5 handover; this ledger records the objective criteria without pre-claiming that later gate.
